errors.evidence: The description states there are six lines on the chart, but there are actually seven. The line corresponding to the 'SBP' strategy is completely omitted from the description.

errors.text_span: Линията „DiP“ е съставена от лилави триъгълни маркери и сплошна лилава линия; започва при стойност 45 при време 0
errors.evidence: The description states the 'DiP' line starts at a value of 45 at time 0. The chart shows this line starts slightly below 45, at approximately 44.

errors.text_span: достига връх около 60 при време 30, след което намалява и се стабилизира на около 60 при време 70
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly describes the trend of the 'AnP' line. It does not peak at time 30 and then decrease; instead, it shows a general upward trend throughout the sampling time.
The description states that the 'AnP' line reaches a peak of about 60. The chart shows that this line never reaches 60; its maximum value is approximately 59 at the end of the time range.
The description claims the 'CoT' line grows to about 64 by time 70. The chart shows its value at time 70 is approximately 63 and it never reaches 64.

The description states that the 'Dynamic w/ Oracle' line starts at a value of 70 at time 0. The chart shows the first data point for this series is at a sampling time greater than 0 (around 2) and its value is approximately 71-72, not 70.

errors.text_span: след което се стабилизира на около 73 до време 70
errors.evidence: The description claims the 'Dynamic w/ Oracle' line stabilizes at around 73. The chart shows clear fluctuations in this line, with values ranging from approximately 72.5 to 74, which is not stabilization.

The description states that the 'Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle' line starts at a value of 70 at time 0. The chart shows the first data point for this series is at a sampling time greater than 0 (around 2) with a value of approximately 72.

errors.text_span: след което се стабилизира на около 83 до време 70
errors.evidence: The description states that the 'Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle' line stabilizes at around 83. The chart shows that the line continues to slowly increase, reaching approximately 84 by time 70. Describing this as stabilization is an over-generalization.
The description states that there are six lines identified in the legend, but there are actually seven lines in the plot and the legend. The line for 'L2M' is completely omitted from the description.
The red line for 'Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle' is described as a dotted line ('punktierte Linie'), but the figure shows it as a dashed line ('gestrichelte Linie').
The description states that the 'AnP' line starts at about 52% accuracy. However, the plot shows the orange 'AnP' line starting at an accuracy of approximately 45% at Sampling Time 0.

errors.text_span: bleibt über die gesamte Sampling-Zeit relativ konstant bei etwa 74%
errors.evidence: The description claims the 'Dynamic w/ Oracle' line remains relatively constant at about 74%. The line actually shows noticeable fluctuations between approximately 71% and 74%, so describing it as constant at a single value is an over-generalization that misrepresents its trend.
The description states that the 'SBP' line starts at about 50% accuracy. The plot shows the beige 'SBP' line starting at an accuracy of approximately 45% at Sampling Time 0.

errors.text_span: erreicht bei einer Sampling-Zeit von 70 etwa 62%
errors.evidence: The description states the 'CoT' line ends at about 62%. The plot shows it ends at approximately 64%, which is the highest of the lower cluster of lines.
